title.narrative: FWUCA-International Youth Festival “The Planet of ART – 2024

description.narrative: The International Youth Festival “The Planet of ART” is a unique platform, which has been implemented since 1999 and united over 75 000 talented children and youth from over 45 states. The finalists of the project are invited to Kazakhstan for the educational and cultural program, where they have an opportunity to visit a series of trainings and workshops, to learn about different cultures and to gain valuable experience. A particularly significant moment will be the implementation of an exhibition at UNESCO headquarters in Paris in November 2024. This event will open up new horizons for the participants allowing them to present their works to the international community and become part of a global dialogue in the field of art.
